items.mainData: As part of a major internal information system overhaul, designed, modernized, and developed critical applications dedicated to inbound document management.
highlights:
Acquisition & modernization:
• Rebuilt the Spring Batch / Spring Integration acquisition environment handling a critical flow of roughly 20 million documents per year.
• Led a major technology migration from Java 8 to Java 21 and from Spring 4 to recent versions.
• Improved maintainability by replacing XML configuration with the Spring Integration Java DSL.
• Built high-performance business APIs with Spring Web and WebFlux.

Email processing & innovation:
• Rewrote the application component dedicated to automated business email processing.
• Implemented Microsoft Graph for mailbox connectivity and integrated Google Vertex AI for content analysis.

AI-assisted development & engineering practices:
• Integrated AI into development workflows to increase productivity and improve code quality.
• Defined and applied prompt engineering practices: strict scope framing, token usage optimization, and critical review of generated output.

Document management infrastructure & user portal:
• Developed the batch and API infrastructure connected to the document management platform for insertion, retrieval, and large-scale extraction.
• Contributed to interfaces enabling business users to access archived documents efficiently.
technicalEnvironment: Spring ecosystem (Batch, Integration DSL, Web, WebFlux)

items.mainData: Innovation assignment for Aéroports de Paris. Designed and built from scratch a complete real-time monitoring solution covering birds, aircraft, and noise pollution data.
highlights:
Front-end & mapping:
• Built the web interface with Angular.
• Integrated Leaflet for real-time flight map visualization.

Back-end & microservices:
• Designed a reactive, high-performance back-end architecture with Java Quarkus and Node.js / Express.

Data processing:
• Implemented batch processing with Spring Batch.
• Leveraged Apache Druid for real-time data flow analysis.

IoT & embedded systems:
• Developed and deployed services on Raspberry Pi devices running Unix / Bash to collect, process, and forward telemetry data to the application.

items.mainData: Within an Agile team, contributed to the complete redesign and continuous evolution of the MGEN.fr web portal, a high-traffic platform serving several million members.
highlights:
Redesign & development:
• Designed and developed the new full-stack architecture with Spring Boot and Angular in a high-availability context.
• Defined and documented REST API contracts with OpenAPI / Swagger.
• Implemented and managed CI/CD pipelines with CloudBees.

Maintenance & continuous improvement:
• Delivered enhancements on the legacy J2EE and PL/SQL architecture.
• Reduced technical debt and improved code quality with CAST and SonarQube.
• Provided production support and updated batch scripts to keep environments stable.
